title: testforblock
description: Tests whether a certain block is in a specific location.

position.title: position
position.description: Required. A `vector` of the location the block to test.

tilename.title: tileName
tilename.description: Required. An `enum` of the block to test for.

blockstates.title: blockStates
blockstates.description: Optional. The `block states` to match when testing.
